svg.title: Connecting an agent with OAuth
svg.desc: 1. The agent registers itself as a public client through dynamic client registration. 2. Its authorization request with a PKCE challenge appears in the app as a connection request. 3. The owner approves it with a PIN and may narrow the scopes. 4. The agent exchanges the one-time code (valid five minutes) and its PKCE verifier for a token bound to the store's audience. 5. The token is stored as a SHA-256 hash, expires after 90 days and can be revoked from the app.
